# Anne Shirley & Harrison

- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Friend of — [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) — good friends and neighbours who converse regularly · since v2  <sub>[v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P39](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0039), [v2 IV Different Opinions P28](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0028), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P55](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0055)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> Anne's peaceful afternoon reading [Virgil](../codex/tech.md#virgil) is interrupted by her angry neighbor, Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), who confronts her after her cow strays into his oats field. Later, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns home and discusses the incident and family matters with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), after which Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) arrives and shares local gossip about incoming residents.
>
> — v2 · I An Irate Neighbor

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P3](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0003), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P28](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0028), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045)_

> On their way back from [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) discover a Jersey cow in Mr. Harrison's oat field. Believing it to be her own unruly cow [Dolly](../character/dolly.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) impetuously sells the animal on the spot to Mr. [Shearer](../character/shearer.md). Upon returning home, she discovers [Dolly](../character/dolly.md) safe in her pen and realizes in horror that she has mistakenly sold Mr. Harrison's cow.
>
> — v2 · II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure

_Sources: [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P12](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0012), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P24](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0024), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P28](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0028), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P35](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0035)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) to confess that she accidentally sold his cow, offering her own cow in exchange. Despite initial squabbling and insults from his parrot [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) accepts her apology, trades cows, and invites [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to share a cake and tea with him. They become friends, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home to happily share the good outcome with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).
>
> — v2 · III Mr. Harrison at Home

_Sources: [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P20](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0020), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P23](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0023), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P35](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0035), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P53](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0053)_

> On the eve of beginning their teaching jobs, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) debate whether corporal punishment is ever necessary in school. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) speaks with Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), who also scoffs at her ideal of governing pupils purely through affection. The next morning, a anxious [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) drinks ginger tea prepared by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) before setting off to school.
>
> — v2 · IV Different Opinions

_Sources: [v2 IV Different Opinions P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v2 IV Different Opinions P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007), [v2 IV Different Opinions P35](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0035), [v2 IV Different Opinions P41](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0041)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) continue their canvassing efforts, encountering a variety of colorful neighbors across [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). Upon hearing that [Lorenzo White](../character/lorenzo-white.md) has just had a newborn son, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) seizes the opportunity to secure a large five-dollar donation from the proud father. Later that evening, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), but he refuses to contribute to the cause.
>
> — v2 · VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P44](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0044), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P49](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0049), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P55](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0055), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P57](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0057)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), and the hall painting project with Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) before leaving for home. Shortly after [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md) finishes painting the hall, Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) discovers it has been painted bright blue instead of green due to a mix-up with the paint numbers. [The Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers) are initially devastated, but the rest of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) rallies in sympathy and support for them against the [Pyes](../codex/factions.md#pyes).
>
> — v2 · IX A Question of Color

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P15](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0015), [v2 IX A Question of Color P28](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0028), [v2 IX A Question of Color P32](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0032), [v2 IX A Question of Color P40](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0040)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) invites [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to celebrate her spring "adopted birthday" with a picnic walk through the woods alongside [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md). On Saturday, the four girls explore new paths, name a woodland pool [Crystal Lake](../codex/places.md#crystal-lake), and discover Hester Gray's forgotten overgrown garden, where [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) tells Hester's tragic and romantic story.
>
> — v2 · XIII A Golden Picnic

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P1](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0001), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P8](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0008), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P44](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0044), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P51](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0051)_

> After [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) publish a mock newspaper note about Uncle Abe's weather predictions, a severe severe hailstorm strikes [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) on the exact predicted day, causing massive devastation to crops, trees, and windows. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) weather the storm at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with the twins, later learning of the damage around town, including the death of Mr. Harrison's parrot, [Ginger](../character/ginger.md).
>
> — v2 · XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country

_Sources: [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P3](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0003), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P24](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0024), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P43](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0043)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers that Mr. Harrison's wife, [Emily](../character/emily.md), has unexpectedly arrived in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) to reunite with him. The news quickly spreads through the neighborhood and school, leading Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) to step in and assist [Emily](../character/emily.md). Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) at his newly cleaned home, where he prepares to explain the backstory of his marriage.
>
> — v2 · XXV An Avonlea Scandal

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P16](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0016), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P28](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0028), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P43](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0043), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P55](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0055)_

> Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) explains to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) how he and his wife [Emily](../character/emily.md) originally separated over domestic habits and his parrot [Ginger](../character/ginger.md) before reconciling. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stays to eat tea with the Harrisons, walks back across the fields with [Emily](../character/emily.md), and later puts [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) to bed at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) while conversing with [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).
>
> — v2 · XXV An Avonlea Scandal

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P56](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0056), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P59](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0059), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P60](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0060), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P71](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0071)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) help Miss Lavendar and Charlotta the Fourth prepare for Miss Lavendar's wedding at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). The ceremony goes wonderfully as the sun breaks through the clouds, and the guests see off the newlyweds. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) waits with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) at the quiet house, where a moment of realization sparks a shift in how she perceives [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and her own maturity.
>
